value.rationale: Designing fixed-dimensional local-mean preprocessing to minimize a rank-specific worst-case integration error is a natural approximation-number problem. The exact answer covers every N and k and completely classifies nonuniform integer-quantized optimizers; it exposes a genuine objective conflict: second singular optimum necessarily breaks uniformity even though uniformity uniquely optimizes all Schatten norms. This resolves a structural mesh-design question rather than an arbitrary finite parameter slice.
